notes.title: Important announcement about Early Quest 2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
Today I announce the development plan for the game:
We have evaluated and decided to change the engine, so we will rewrite the code and report all the functions implemented so far.
As we will be using a newer engine, the minimum requirements may change.
However, the visual rendering will remain similar.

I hope you will appreciate our choice!

P.S. We have another announcement ready, stay tuned!

notes.title: Early Quest 2 - summary of the situation
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Even though I am no longer updating we are moving forward with the development.
We are at a particular point, however, and I therefore wanted to share the situation with you.
We are actually evaluating an engine change and testing several.
Thank you for your understanding.

To narrow down the choices I would therefore like to give you a choice:
1) you prefer to keep the old school 2d style
2) you prefer it to be updated to a more modern 2d style (requires more work)
3) do you prefer it to be upgraded to a 2d 3d style (requires a lot more work)

We are waiting for the news!
For any questions please do not hesitate to contact us!

We will update soon!

notes.title: Early Access 0.13.35
notes.notes:
Important improvements:
Minarology added!
Now you can raise the level of mineralogy! The effects will be effective even if the consultation from the menu is not yet available.

Various fixes and improvements:
formulas that are not lost once used such as potions
added map
correct starting wood, now one wood is needed for pickaxe and ax instead of 2
updated monster designs
updated map resources
event correction
modification of the energy system
now herbs give energy when consumed

notes.title: Early Access 0.13.25
notes.notes:
ATTENTION: TO ENJOY FULLY OF ALL THE CHANGES, IT IS RECOMMENDED TO START A NEW GAME!

The changes in this update are:

Energy system:
Added energy system with display of the bar in the menu
Potions, fish and coconut recharge your energy

Time management:
Increased the length of the days, now a day lasts 24 minutes
Having changed the way the bed works, now sleeping makes time pass
Fixed weather function, now no longer resets when changing maps
You can check the time inside the beach hut by clicking on the clock

Fixes and additions:
Correct places to use the ladder
Red Potion Formula (fixed asking for blue stones)
Red and blue potion now make the container empty after use
Now you can create the empty container
Red and blue potion formula no longer wear out after use
Added missions
Added monsters and updated images
Now Weiry's luck also counts in fishing (and subsequent random-release events)
Added all basic spells and scripted for leveling and adding mana
The display of spell levels has been corrected, now writes when it is at maximum

notes.title: Version 0.13.05 Early Access
notes.notes:
Various fixes
Added levels to spells
Added the first mastery (carpentry)
Added menus

With this update, we're starting to introduce the first power-up feature - hard work!

Starting with the carpentry, each time you collect wood you will increase the relative experience. The classification is divided into 4 grades: beginner, intermediate, expert and master. Each degree in turn is divided into several levels.
Each time you level up you will have a permanent stat boost in return, the higher the level the greater the increase
